notes: Portrait, a wall of pale wooden shelves of New Zealand books in a second-hand shop, photographed from the left end at about 30 degrees, daylight from the left, slight softness on the far shelves, no glare; the shelves recede so the right-hand half is small and oblique. English throughout, with Maori words in titles. Titles from spines, plus the face-out books on the top shelf (The Coast, Beneath New Zealand Seas, the two Historic Buildings volumes, labelled by island as printed on their covers) and the crate of books on the floor (A Limestone Landscape, The Fantail). Civil War is a Marvel comic collection lying on the floor. Partial: New Zealanders at War (cover cut by the top of the frame, 'Zealanders AT WAR'). Corrections to the draft: the history is 'The Oxford History of New Zealand Literature in English'; 'C.K. Stead' is an author name, 'Katherine Mansfield' is a face-out book whose title is hidden by a sticker, 'The New Zealand Wars', 'Mata Hari' and 'Alfie's Reunion' could not be found. Left out: the right-hand half of every shelf (too oblique), the face-out marine fishes book at the top (title cut), the Life magazine and other magazines on the floor, the Mineralogical Magazine stack at the bottom, the walking and road guides at the bottom left whose spines are thin, and a spine reading only 'Janet Frame'. Non-book items: a red plastic camera-shaped object and a vintage box camera on the top shelf, wooden 'NZ' letters, an 'ABC' crate. Drafted by claude-sonnet-5 (extraction 79), verified by an agent.
